title: Repeated Authentication Failures from One Source IP
description: Alert when at least the configured number of failed login events from one source IP fall within a rolling time window.
false_positive_notes: Shared NAT addresses may aggregate failures from multiple legitimate users.
Users or automation with stale credentials can generate repeated failures.
known_limitations: Attempts distributed across multiple source IPs can stay below the per-IP threshold.
Slow attempts spread beyond the time window may not alert.
This rule does not by itself detect a successful account compromise.
